questions.text: Are all H3 p_out vectors exactly transportable through the complete forward H4 linear layer into the following mask?
For each fixed round count, are all H3 p_in vectors exactly absorbable into the effective masks at nonlinear boundaries, including the terminal-key exception?
Does the unchanged frozen RTL compute byte-identical outputs when driven by zero offsets and the independently collapsed effective masks?
Can the gate detect a genuinely non-translation-equivalent rotor-position family rather than declaring every keyed S-box absorbable?

construction.original_recurrence: X_0 = P XOR M_0; X_{r+1} = L_{w_r}(SBOX^32(X_r XOR A_r) XOR B_r) XOR M_{r+1}
construction.linear_layer: L_w = AES MixColumns after forward H4 RowShift w, over GF(2) with polynomial 0x11b

stage_a.name: prefix_compatible_output_offset_collapse
stage_a.formula: Mprime_0=M_0; Mprime_{r+1}=M_{r+1} XOR L_{w_r}(B_r); retain A_r; set B_r=0
stage_a.semantics_warning: These 800 bytes are 384 input offsets plus 416 transformed masks, not the E256-W 384 rotor IDs plus 416 masks.

stage_b.name: fixed_round_full_offset_collapse
stage_b.formula: K_0=M_0 XOR A_0; K_r=L_{w_{r-1}}(B_{r-1}) XOR M_r XOR A_r for 1<=r<R; K_R=L_{w_{R-1}}(B_{R-1}) XOR M_R
stage_b.canonical_recurrence: Z_0=P XOR K_0; Z_{r+1}=L_{w_r}(SBOX^32(Z_r)) XOR K_{r+1}
stage_b.terminal_rule: K_R excludes A_R and must be derived separately for each tested prefix R

formal_contract.scope: compositional proof of one complete H3/H4 round: the nonlinear-boundary input is identical by construction as U=SBOX^32(state XOR A), and a Yosys SAT miter proves the remaining linear identity for arbitrary 256-bit U, B, and M under fixed certified tuple (0,1,3,4)

proof_decomposition.nonlinear_boundary: Both original and canonical forms evaluate the same deterministic AES S-box bank on the same state XOR A input; the 256-entry AES S-box hash is pinned and the unchanged dual-core RTL comparison checks integration.
proof_decomposition.sat_lemma: Prove L(U XOR B) XOR M = L(U) XOR L(B) XOR M for arbitrary U, B, M. This is stronger than testing selected S-box outputs because U is unconstrained.
proof_decomposition.reason: The monolithic miter duplicated 64 table S-box instances and timed out before SAT despite the nonlinear layer being irrelevant to the algebraic identity.
proof_decomposition.detected_by: first fail-closed gate execution after software and 64-row RTL completion; no SAT result or receipt was emitted
proof_decomposition.scope_of_change: Proof decomposition only. Formulas, software/RTL coverage, controls, predictions, verdicts, material accounting, and interpretation are unchanged.

formal_contract.correct_mode: prove mismatch=0 between original_linear=L(U XOR B) XOR M and canonical_linear=L(U) XOR L(B) XOR M
